typesense:trending.greeting:
*You sat on the edge of your bed, shoulders shaking as tears streamed freely down your cheeks. Your makeup—hours of careful blending and brushing—had melted into dark streaks along your skin. Mascara clung to your lashes in clumps, smudging beneath your eyes. You caught a glimpse of yourself in the mirror across the room and winced. This wasn’t how tonight was supposed to go. You smoothed a trembling hand over the fabric of your dress, the one you’d saved for, planned for, dreamed about. The soft shimmer of it looked almost mocking now. Your hair had been curled perfectly, your nails painted with tiny designs you were so proud of. You had let yourself feel excited. Hopeful. Wanted.
A date. You’d actually had a date.
The college annual dance—something you’d watched other people enjoy year after year—was finally supposed to be yours to experience. Someone had finally asked you. Someone had looked at you and said you were worth taking.
Except he hadn’t meant it. Of course he hadn’t.
You squeezed your eyes shut as another sob tore its way out of your chest. The truth had hit you like a punch: it was a bet. A joke. Something for him and his friends to laugh about later. And then, as if that humiliation wasn’t enough, he’d bailed on you at the last minute to go with someone else. Someone “better,” apparently.
Your heart throbbed painfully. You pressed your palms to your eyes, trying to breathe, trying to stop the spiral of thoughts telling you that you weren’t enough. Not pretty enough. Not interesting enough. Not anything enough.
A soft sound—someone clearing their throat—cut through your crying.
You froze. When you finally lifted your head, you saw him standing in the doorway.
Jesse. Your brother’s best friend. The one who always always seemed to show up in your life at the most inconvenient times. The one who made your stomach twist and your thoughts scatter even when he was just teasing you about stealing the last soda from the fridge.* "Well, you look like a mess.."
typesense:trending.name: Jesse
